title: Kinetic-isolation of the anchored nested commutator
question: Does the exact zero-time nested commutator exposed by the coordinate-resolvent anchor depend only on the quadratic kinetic part T, with every position-only onsite and bond potential V removable before the unbounded estimate?

model.prefix_split: H=T+V, where T is the sum of included p_x^2/(2 chi) terms and V contains only included coordinate polynomials
model.analytic_target: Use the isolated [B,[T,A_z]] as the input to a phase-local BKM/graph-norm estimate; do not infer that estimate from the finite check

adversarial_review.check: T and V are rebuilt term-by-term for every actual bond prefix in both orders; no full-H shortcut is substituted.
The coordinate commutator is evaluated for every translated site and both resolvent adjoints; a momentum mutation is required to break it.
The nested isolation is tested at three potential scales, including zero and doubled potential, rather than inferred from one parameter point.
All matrices are bounded oscillator truncations; the cancellation does not supply a uniform domain or thermodynamic estimate.
BKM locality, shell summability, all uniformities, Cook/common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks only the abstract ring commutator implication; finite matrices, domains, weighted norms and all limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: At the finite anchor, all position-only potential terms disappear from the first nonzero relative-cocycle coefficient, leaving a kinetic commutator target.
qft_interface.open: The phase-local BKM/graph-norm estimate, shell summability, cutoff/source/volume/shape uniformity, invariant domain, Cook limit, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary finite Q3 interface only; no production-owner transfer or physical-sector conclusion is supplied.

boundary: Claim-nonbearing finite checkpoint only. It proves no phase-local BKM estimate, shell summability, domain theorem, Cook/common-alpha convergence, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A result.
no_overclaim: The finite cancellation identifies a simpler analytic target but does not bound [B,[T,A_z]] or its modular companion uniformly. Higher time coefficients can reintroduce V and all unbounded and thermodynamic obligations remain.
